In Holten, defeat Godwin & Sigbert.
From Holten there are 2 branches to clear: Wolvenhold (Oswin) and Holten Estate (story).
Clear both branches: Wolvenhold (Oswin) and Holten Estate (story).
Wolvenhold → defeat Oswin, the Dread Warden → use Warden's Ledger.
objectives.note: +2 Skill Points; boss can also drop a unique + Vaal Orb.

objectives.text: Holten Estate → up 2 staircases through the maze → upper floor → defeat Thane Wulfric & Lady Elswyth.
Complete Interlude 5.1 → return to town.

acts.subtitle: Take ALL quests on the 3 mini-maps. Recommended order: Interlude II (center) → Interlude I (left) → Interlude III (right). Center is longest/hardest — run while monsters are lower level.

acts.title: Interlude II — Khari Bazaar

objectives.text: Orbala's 7 Boons can be changed anytime by returning to the pillar.
Go to Khari Crossing via the Hooded One.
Defeat Akthi & Anundr → speak to Risu.
Navigation: beetle chests/rune drop lead up the eastern stairs; Wayfinder's Seals point west to Pools of Kathal.
Torbek at Khari Crossing.
Go to Pools of Kathal (WP); has a guaranteed Expedition and the entrance to Sel Khari Sanctuary.
Sel Khari Sanctuary: (Optional) Two Wishes — place Yoon's Barya & Rangeen's Barya to choose 2 rare jewelry.
End of Sel Khari Sanctuary → defeat Elzarah, the Cobra Lord → Asala & Jado appear.
Activate Molten One's Gift → enter Skullmaw Stairway in Molten Shrine, find seals.
If Molten One's Gift is bugged, find all seals then reset the instance. Skullmaw Stairway is inside Molten Shrine, northeast.
Enter Qimah → use Orbala's Pillar → choose 1 of 7 Boons; can be changed anytime.
Summon Jado to open Qimah Reservoir.
Qimah Reservoir → 2 Sacred Wells.
Rare Bloodbilge → click giant vase to spawn.
Defeat finale boss Azmadi, the Faridun Prince → interact with Grand Barya → Jado / Asala.
Complete Interlude 5.2 → return to town.

acts.subtitle: Take ALL quests on the 3 mini-maps. Recommended order: Interlude II (center) → Interlude I (left) → Interlude III (right). Center is longest/hardest — run while monsters are lower level.

acts.title: Interlude III — Mount Kriar → Maps

objectives.text: Mount Kriar has a fairly stable layout/POIs; Elder Maddox is usually around 10–11 o'clock.
Go to Mount Kriar via the Hooded One → enter Ashen Forest through The Glade.
Find Ancient Monument in Ashen Forest.
objectives.note: Skill Gem level scales with Interlude completion order.

objectives.text: Go to Kriar Village → follow the 2 wisps → defeat Lythara, the Wayward Spear.
Interlude Skill/Spirit gem levels scale with the order you complete them, so gem level is not fixed.
Go to Glacial Tarn → enter Howling Caves → defeat The Abominable Yeti → take Icy Tusks.
Turn in Icy Tusks for Hilda.
Return to Glacial Tarn → defeat Rakkar, the Frozen Talon to the NW to open the path to Kriar Peaks.
Kriar Peaks → find Elder Maddox around the 10–11 o'clock direction.
Go to Etched Ravine → defeat Stormgore, the Guardian → open The Cuachic Vault.
Enter The Cuachic Vault; (Optional) Ancient Treasures: open Sealed Vaults with Small Soul Cores.
Reach finale bosses Zolin & Zelina → defeat them to continue Fate of the Vaal.
FATE OF THE VAAL: 6 Vaal Beacons are spread across Mount Kriar zones. Stormgore opens Cuachic Vault; defeat Zolin & Zelina to continue the storyline.
Fate of the Vaal: 6 Vaal Beacons are spread across Mount Kriar zones; complete them to power the Temple.
After completing all 3 Interludes, speak to The Hooded One in Kingsmarch.
Go to Oriath → speak to Farrow → The Hooded One → Doryani.
Open the Endgame Atlas / Maps → start your first map (Lv58–60).
